title: A sunset to remember in Tuscany
content: We took a wine tasting tour just outside Florence. The Chianti was exquisite, but the views of the rolling hills as the sun went down were absolutely priceless. Highly recommend booking a late afternoon slot.

title: First time paragliding!
content: Bir Billing is magical. I was terrified before takeoff, but once you are in the air, the silence and the view of the Himalayas are overwhelming. The instructors were highly professional.

title: Navigating the Louvre
content: Tip: buy your tickets online in advance and enter through the Carrousel du Louvre to avoid the massive lines at the glass pyramid. We spent 4 hours and still only saw a fraction of it!

title: Spicy Pav Bhaji at Juhu
content: Nothing beats Mumbai street food. The flavors are intense. Make sure you have a strong stomach or stick to the highly rated stalls. A local guide makes a huge difference.

title: Diving in the Maldives
content: Saw three manta rays and a sea turtle on our first dive! The water clarity here is unbelievable. Worth every penny for the advanced open water certification.

title: Ganges Rafting Adventure
content: Rishikesh did not disappoint. The rapids were thrilling but felt safe with our guide. Cliff jumping midway was the highlight of the trip!

title: Autumn leaves in Kyoto
content: The temple gardens in late November are breathtaking. The contrast of the golden pavilion with the red maple leaves is something out of a painting.

title: Surfing at dawn
content: Uluwatu is not for beginners, but watching the sunrise from the lineup is a spiritual experience. The local surf community is incredibly welcoming.

title: Dune bashing at sunset
content: The 4x4 ride was exhilarating. The transition from the ultra-modern city to the vast desert in just an hour is what makes Dubai so unique.

title: Jungfrau Skiing
content: The infrastructure here is unparalleled. Taking the train inside the mountain to reach the slopes is a unique Swiss experience. Snow conditions were perfect.

title: Hot Air Balloon over Amber Fort
content: Floating silently over the historic forts of Jaipur as the sun rises is an experience I will never forget. A must-do in Rajasthan.

title: The Met is massive
content: You can easily spend three days here. Focus on a few wings rather than trying to see it all. The Egyptian art wing is spectacular.
